# NOSTALGIC BakaSU (ReSukiSU) 35212

This release provides 158 checksum-verified OnePlus kernel packages built with BakaSU 35212 and SuSFS 2.3.0.

- 38 kernel 5.10 packages
- 25 kernel 5.15 packages
- 53 kernel 6.1 packages
- 34 kernel 6.6 packages
- 8 kernel 6.12 packages
- OxygenOS 14, 15 and 16 targets
- Normal universal BakaSU manager
- Spoofed universal BakaSU manager
- NoMount v2.0.0 companion module

BakaSU is the current continuation and new identity of ReSukiSU. The combined name is shown so existing ReSukiSU users can recognize the project.

Use only the ZIP matching the exact device, OxygenOS generation and kernel version. Keep a known-good boot image and recovery path before flashing.

The included `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all 158 kernel ZIPs, the NoMount module and both manager APKs.

Manager source: Baka-SU/BakaSU commit `e5423590bec3e24daffa4e9555c9592071319c68`.

name: NOSTALGIC 15 Kernel 6.12 & 6.6 | KSUN33301 | SUSFS 2.3.0 | NoMount 2.0.0
body:
# NOSTALGIC Kernel 6.12 and 6.6 release: 15 OnePlus targets

KernelSU Next 33301 (`d3c68954`) + Simonpunk SUSFS v2.3.0 + NoMount Inline v2.0.0.

This release adds 15 device-specific OxygenOS 16 packages:

- 8 Android 16 / kernel 6.12 targets
- 7 Android 15 / kernel 6.6 targets

All 15 targets completed clean Clang O2 builds in the guarded VM run. Every AnyKernel3 ZIP passed archive-integrity and SHA-256 verification after download.

## Downloads

- 15 device/OxygenOS/kernel-specific AnyKernel3 ZIPs
- `SHA256SUMS` covering every ZIP

Match the exact device, OxygenOS generation, Android generation, and kernel version before flashing. Keep a known-working boot backup and recovery method available.

## Validation scope

All packages were build-tested and their ZIP integrity and checksums were verified. These 15 packages are not claimed to be device boot-tested.

The KernelSU Next manager APKs and NoMount v2.0 companion package remain available at the top of the NOSTALGIC catalog.

Credits: OnePlus OSS, KernelSU Next, Simonpunk, The Wild James, fatalcoder524, maxsteeel and AnyKernel3.

Built with love by NOSTALGIC @Reals3s.

- Original NoMount v2.0.0 release metamodule (versionCode 291, maxsteeel).
- KernelSU Next v3.4.0-7-gd3c68954 (33301) normal and spoofed manager APKs supplied by the maintainer.

Match the exact device, OxygenOS generation, and kernel version. Keep a known-working boot backup and recovery method before flashing.

## Validation scope
All kernel packages were build-tested and ZIP integrity/checksums verified. The maintainer reported successful OP13R pilot-stack boot and functional testing; the other devices are not claimed to be boot-tested. APK archive integrity was checked; independent APK signing-certificate verification was not performed.
